gate_results.notes: Deterministic re-run inventory at the validated commit: both Source trees (PixelLab/ 180px and PixelLab128/ 128px) independently contain all four presentation/skin combinations, all eight PixelLab base directions in both standing and walk poses, and 6-frame walk cycles for all four diagonal gameplay facings in every combination; 1018 tracked files / 448 PNGs under Source, all under a selected/ folder, zero unparsed or duplicate-named frames. The 224 frames in the PixelLab/ tree (the set this record authorizes for NSC-062, see VAL-002) were additionally decoded and confirmed 180x180 RGBA with transparent corner pixels. See the attached artifact for the full per-check output.

Assistant-only review per NSC-061's contract (matching the NSC-063 precedent): representation equality across the four combinations is measured as identical structure (56 frames each) in the authorized PixelLab/ tree; the exact source-art files authorized for NSC-062 are the 488 files (224 PNG + 264 .meta) under each combination's Source/PixelLab/<combo>/selected/, per PIXELLAB_GENERATION.md's explicit authorization line and NSC-062 AC-001, and excluding Source/PixelLab128/ which is a separate, later, differently-authorized remake owned by NSC-095 for NSC-096, not NSC-062. The dark-but-cute horror-comedy assessment rests on this being the family PIXELLAB_GENERATION.md already documented against AC-002/AC-003 plus the re-verified structural completeness; no pixel-level visual inspection of all 224 authorized frames is claimed. No Vincent review is claimed or required by this gate. See the attached artifact for the full reasoning.

human_approval.notes: NSC-061 contract requires assistant source-art review only (VAL-002 text: 'The assistant verifies...'), matching the NSC-063 precedent's assistant-only review. Vincent's downstream in-Unity visual approval belongs to NSC-062 AC-006, and separately to NSC-095/NSC-077 for the PixelLab128 family; neither is this gate.
